claim_boundary.risk_limited_mode: statistical state-entry risk at or below 0.5 percent; not deterministic exactness
claim_boundary.strict_mode: consistent with the frozen canonical execution path
claim_boundary.positive_evidence: direct restore only for an exact contract digest and only after canary renewal
claim_boundary.negative_evidence: persistent only inside its recorded execution applicability cone
claim_boundary.capacity: admission and active-session deadline are distinct from queued-session waiting time
